thread:
maya: FYI - QA just flagged a spike in "unassigned" leads during the 10:00 rollout window. trend looks like assignment lag, not straight drop. anyone on routing?
jonah: saw the spike. router traces show a race where enrichment returns after the rr slot expires so mapping never attaches and lead goes to unassigned fallback.
priya: that matches an earlier incident. the root is TTL vs slot timing when enrichment is slow. we lowered TTL to 25s last week to reduce latency but it makes this race more likely.
hubspot-bot: metric.alert: inbound.handoff.unassigned_rate increased from 1.2% -> 6.4% over 5m window source=hs-sync
katie: proposal: don't immediately fall through on enrich timeout. introduce a "staging_hold" state that keeps lead in-memory for up to 75s awaiting enrich. if enrich completes, attach owner and proceed; if not, mark pending_quality and route to overflow pool with a holdback tag. prevents immediate unassigned.
maya: staging_hold makes sense. we should also add a partial_assign flag so owner mapping can be filled later and SDRs won't contact until enrich passes QC.
jonah: implementation notes: router change is small. add states: READY -> STAGING_HOLD (ttl=75) -> FALLBACK. also emit inbound.handoff.staging_count and assign_lag_p90.
priya: small UX note: HubSpot workflows and Salesforce sync need to tolerate pending_quality tag. otherwise owners get clobbered later. we'll add mapping that defers owner write until enrich completes or after 30m.
katie: rollout plan: canary at 10% for 1 hour, instrument with a "staging_sample" boolean on leads so we can query. If unassigned_rate drops, ramp to 50% then 100%. rollback if unassigned_rate > 1.5x baseline or assignment latency > 2x.
maya: also add a manual override for VIP leads so they don't get held. VIPs should always route to sales immediately with best-effort enrich metadata.
jonah: quick config snippet for canary:
```
router.round_robin: {
  staging_hold_enabled: true,
  staging_ttl_seconds: 75,
  canary_pct: 10
}
```
priya: I'll update the HS/SF mapping playbook and the inbound runbook with queries to find staging leads: `hubspot.property:pending_quality=true AND created:>now-1h`.
katie: I'll update the overflow pool rules: exclude pending_quality from outbound sequences for 30m and tag them with "awaiting_enrich" for SDR dashboards.
maya: owners: jonah -> code change + canary, priya -> HS/SF mapping doc + runbook tests, katie -> overflow rules and dashboard tag, me -> CSM/ops comms and SLA note. target: canary start 10:30 UTC. 1-hour canary, then review.
hubspot-bot: deploy.scheduled: canary=10% scheduled_by=maya start=1769999400
jonah: starting canary now, will post periodic deltas. pls report any unexpected customer-visible drops.
maya: thanks team. after postmortem we'll look at longer-term: restore TTL to conservative value if backend steady, add enrichment circuit-breaker and db replica monitoring to prevent future bursts.
